join_notes: Each overlay row carries `related_requirement_ids`, which are ids in requirements.json. That is the join key a downstream CTS workstream can use to move from a consumer need to a core obligation.
Overlay rows are consumer requirements, not Khronos obligations. They are deliberately kept in a separate file so that a consumer need is never reported as a core 1.4 requirement or as a CTS result.
Classification here uses the same vocabulary as requirements.json: mandatory (for this consumer), conditional, optional.

core_conformance_is_not_enough.summary: A driver can satisfy every mandatory core obligation and still fail these consumers, because both depend on optional feature bits, optional extensions and platform integration that core does not require.
examples: The deliberately pinned DXVK v2.6.2 D3D11 FL11_0 baseline is derived from its immutable Vulkan Profiles document. It requires Vulkan 1.3.204, two named extensions and the exact feature/property set in dxvk_v262_profile.json; requirements from DXVK 3.x are a separate future target.

ParaLLEl-RDP requires 8/16-bit storage access, at least three descriptor sets with UBO and texel-buffer bindings, push constants and specialization constants, and shared-memory/barrier/atomic compute kernels. Core conformance does not imply any of those.
Neither consumer is validated by core CTS results alone; both need their own acceptance runs, and both are named here as targets, not as supported configurations.

consumers.title: ParaLLEl-RDP (N64 RDP renderer)

revision.note: Carried over from an earlier project-level RDP audit and re-verified as an existing upstream commit; it is also the master head at retrieval time.

dependency_pins.note: Most Vulkan usage lives in Granite rather than in parallel-rdp itself.

consumers.evidence_basis: Static source reading only. No PS5 execution, no compiler build and no performance measurement. Every row below is a requirement derived from the pinned source, not a measured failure.

scopes.description: RDP command stream producing RDRAM and hidden RDRAM output; the next concrete target.
Video interface scanout, filtering and presentation; separate stage.
Integration into a complete N64 emulator; out of scope for this inventory.

requirements.summary: A Vulkan 1.1-or-newer context contract, including extension and pNext feature negotiation, before any rendering starts.
requirements.evidence: Granite context/device initialisation queries version and chains feature structs; the audit pinned Granite context.cpp around the version/property selection path.
requirements.baseline_observation: The pinned baseline rejects non-1.0 apiVersion requests and does not export the 1.1+ pNext query surface.

requirements.summary: 8-bit and 16-bit storage buffer access are required; they are not removable by the small-arithmetic option.
requirements.evidence: rdp_renderer.cpp rejects a device that lacks storageBuffer16BitAccess and storageBuffer8BitAccess; the shader ABI aliases 8/16/32-bit views of the same buffers.
requirements.baseline_observation: Not advertised or validated end to end at the baseline.

requirements.summary: At least three descriptor sets: set 0 with VRAM views, set 1 with setup/state/LUT/texel-buffer bindings, set 2 with a uniform buffer.
requirements.evidence: The pinned shader descriptor ABI declares set 0 bindings 0-2, set 1 bindings 0-12 including a uniform texel buffer, and set 2 binding 0 as a std140 uniform block.
requirements.baseline_observation: Runtime compute now accepts up to four descriptor sets; a three-set storage/uniform/uniform-texel configuration has strict native hardware acceptance. Descriptor arrays remain outside that acceptance fixture.

requirements.summary: Uniform buffers and uniform texel buffer views with exact view formats.
requirements.evidence: The RDP shader set uses a std140 uniform block and a readonly utextureBuffer for a divider LUT.
requirements.baseline_observation: Uniform buffers and R32_UINT uniform texel-buffer views are implemented end to end and accepted by a strict native compute oracle; R32_SINT/R32_SFLOAT have object/encoder contracts only.

requirements.summary: Push constants with correct storage, command snapshot and cache-key participation.
requirements.evidence: The renderer records push constants around dispatch and the shader modules declare them.
requirements.baseline_observation: Up to 256 bytes of push constants now participate in pipeline layouts, cache identity and immutable command snapshots; the public compute consumer has a strict native GPU oracle. Runtime graphics has host/compiler coverage but no separate native push-constant draw oracle.

requirements.evidence: Shaders use specialization constants for local sizes and pipeline creation passes specialization info.
requirements.baseline_observation: Compute and runtime graphics pipelines now accept bounded scalar specialization maps with canonical cache identity. Non-default compute values pass a strict native oracle; specialization-dependent LocalSizeId remains unsupported.

requirements.summary: Compute kernels using shared (local) memory, barriers and atomics for tile binning.
requirements.evidence: The non-subgroup binning kernel uses shared memory, barriers and atomics; disabling subgroup support does not remove that requirement.
requirements.baseline_observation: The compiler adapter supports up to 64 KiB of LDS, and focused upstream shared-variable, barrier and shared-atomic cases pass on hardware; the complete tile-binning workload remains unvalidated.

requirements.summary: Indirect compute dispatch for the optimized rasterization path; deferrable by selecting the ubershader path.
requirements.evidence: The optimized path issues indirect dispatch; the ubershader path avoids it.
requirements.baseline_observation: No indirect command entry points are exposed.

requirements.summary: External host memory import is not mandatory: an upstream staging/write-mask fallback exists when VK_EXT_external_memory_host is absent.
requirements.evidence: The command processor has a staging fallback; the earlier README wording that suggested host-import was mandatory is not what the audited implementation requires.
requirements.baseline_observation: Not advertised; the fallback costs copying and coherency work.

requirements.summary: Synchronization: binary semaphores and fences, or an explicitly serialized adapter that preserves upstream ordering; timeline semaphores are not proven mandatory.
requirements.evidence: The command processor tracks worker/fence progress on the CPU timeline; Granite has optional timeline semaphores and a synchronization2-to-1 conversion path.
requirements.baseline_observation: A single serial native queue exists; semaphore submissions are rejected.

requirements.summary: Transfers and precise visibility between host, transfer and compute stages for staging buffers and masked resolve paths.
requirements.evidence: The renderer performs staging uploads and a masked resolve path with explicit barriers.
requirements.baseline_observation: The existing image-upload path is not general transfer coverage.

requirements.summary: VI scanout needs storage images and textured graphics passes with integer and normalized targets, beyond a descriptor-free BGRA8 triangle profile.
requirements.evidence: The video interface uses R8G8B8A8_UINT storage/color images, RGBA8_UNORM targets, texel buffers and sampled graphics inputs across multiple passes.
requirements.baseline_observation: Separate later stage; recorded so that headless RDP progress is not mistaken for VI support.

requirements.summary: Platform integration: static dispatch or loader negotiation, C++ threads, shader asset/SPIR-V bank loading and error reporting in a headless environment.
requirements.evidence: Granite/context/device construction and the renderer's worker threads and shader bank paths assume a desktop-style host layer.
requirements.baseline_observation: No public port layer exists; desktop WSI is not required for headless RDP tests.

unmeasured: Peak persistent, in-flight and transient compiler memory for the selected shader variants.
Scratch/LDS demand and workgroup occupancy for the binning kernel.
Whether compiler lowering for 8/16-bit accesses is correct and visible through direct memory.
Descriptor maxima actually required across the reachable shader variants.
limits: This overlay authorises no API change and no emulator port.
Initial acceptance is limited to the RDP command scope; VI and emulator integration are separate.
The 256 MiB design budget in the SDK is a software policy, not evidence that this workload fits or fails.

consumers.title: DXVK v2.6.2 (D3D11 feature level 11_0 baseline)
consumers.evidence_basis: Machine-derived from the pinned VP_DXVK_requirements.json profile. dxvk_v262_profile.json is the exact flattened requirement surface and dxvk_v262_matrix.json is the fail-closed join to the current public API, implementation, CTS mapping and native evidence.

requirements.summary: Satisfy every requirement derived from VP_DXVK_d3d11_level_11_0_baseline at API version 1.3.204.
requirements.evidence: The immutable upstream Vulkan Profiles document names six capability sets; tools/derive_dxvk_profile.py flattens them into 62 unique requirements and rejects conflicts or source-identity drift.
requirements.baseline_observation: The public device currently reports 1.0.0; the fail-closed matrix records this as a witnessed blocker.

requirements.summary: Implement and advertise the 1.0 through 1.3 feature/property chains selected by the pinned profile.
requirements.evidence: The derivative preserves each originating capability and structure/member name; the matrix joins each leaf independently rather than promoting an entire version from one passing feature.
requirements.baseline_observation: Only robustBufferAccess currently satisfies all four matrix axes; every absent or unmeasured leaf remains a blocker.

requirements.summary: Provide VK_EXT_robustness2 and VK_EXT_transform_feedback plus the D3D11 baseline graphics features, including geometry/tessellation, blending, BC textures, MSAA and precise occlusion queries.
requirements.evidence: These are the two extensions and the d3d11_baseline/d3d11_level11_0 leaves selected by the pinned profile.
requirements.baseline_observation: Both required extensions and the listed graphics features remain unadvertised; no API-name presence is treated as semantic support.

requirements.summary: A display-oriented deployment additionally needs a surface/swapchain bridge or an explicitly maintained ps5vk_present adaptation.
requirements.evidence: WSI is not part of the Vulkan Profiles baseline file, but DXVK's presenter uses the swapchain path when presenting an application.
requirements.baseline_observation: ps5vk_present reaches VideoOut, but no Vulkan WSI or stock-DXVK integration contract is claimed.

unmeasured: Whether one gfx1013 device configuration can satisfy all 62 profile leaves simultaneously.
Transform feedback, geometry/tessellation stages, BC textures, MSAA and precise query feasibility.
Stock DXVK loader/WSI integration versus a maintained native presentation adaptation.
limits: The one currently satisfied matrix row is not a DXVK compatibility claim.
The overlay describes DXVK v2.6.2 D3D11 FL11_0 baseline exactly; DXVK 3.x/Vulkan 1.4 remains a separate future target.
DXVK itself does not define core Vulkan obligations, so its requirement sets must not be copied into the core inventory as mandatory core rows.
